## Market backdrop

The S&P 500 rose 0.30% (z-score 0.5). Strongest sector: Communication Services (XLC) +1.01%; weakest: Financials (XLF) -0.91%.

## Notable moves

### JPM: -4.49% (z-score -3.17, volume 2.14x normal)
- **What happened:** JPM moved -4.49% on volume 2.14x normal.
- **Vs. sector and market:** JPM fell 4.49%; its sector (Financials, XLF) fell 0.91% and the S&P 500 rose 0.30%. That is 3.58 points worse than its sector, an unusual gap for JPM (z-score -3.2), so the move looks specific to JPM.
- **Likely why:** A senior executive departure was announced. [Example Financial News](https://news.example.com/2026-10-06/jpm-news)
- **Worth watching:** whether the move holds into the next session.

## Quiet

## Coming up

- Thu Oct 8: JPMorgan Chase (JPM): Court hearing in patent case
- Tue Oct 13: Microsoft (MSFT): Court hearing in patent case
